title: Email Privacy & Encryption Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your email privacy risk score and discover how secure your email setup is. Get personalized recommendations for better email security.
description: Assess your email privacy and security risks with our comprehensive calculator. Evaluate your current email provider, encryption usage, and privacy practices to get a personalized risk score and actionable recommendations.

formula: let providerRisk = {gmail: 70, outlook: 65, yahoo: 75, protonmail: 15, tutanota: 20, 'other-secure': 30, 'work-email': 50}[emailProvider] || 50; let volumeMultiplier = {'1-10': 0.8, '10-50': 1.0, '50-100': 1.2, '100+': 1.4}[emailsPerDay] || 1.0; let sensitivityRisk = {never: 0, rarely: 10, sometimes: 20, often: 35, always: 50}[sensitiveContent] || 20; let encryptionReduction = {none: 0, sometimes: -15, 'secure-provider': -35, always: -45}[encryptionUsage] || 0; let trackingReduction = {none: 0, basic: -5, advanced: -15, full: -25}[trackingProtection] || 0; let twoFactorReduction = twoFactorAuth ? -10: 0; let baseRisk = (providerRisk + sensitivityRisk) * volumeMultiplier; let totalRisk = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, baseRisk + encryptionReduction + trackingReduction + twoFactorReduction)); let grade = totalRisk <= 25 ? 'A': totalRisk <= 40 ? 'B': totalRisk <= 60 ? 'C': totalRisk <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; let level = totalRisk <= 25 ? 'Low Risk': totalRisk <= 50 ? 'Moderate Risk': totalRisk <= 75 ? 'High Risk': 'Very High Risk'; return {riskScore: Math.round(totalRisk), securityGrade: grade, riskLevel: level};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your email privacy risk based on your provider's data practices, encryption usage, authentication methods, and privacy protections. Major providers like Gmail scan emails for advertising, while encrypted providers like ProtonMail offer zero-access encryption.
tips: Switch to encrypted email providers like ProtonMail or Tutanota for automatic end-to-end encryption
Enable two-factor authentication on all email accounts to prevent unauthorized access
Use email tracking blockers or privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser to prevent pixel tracking
Create email aliases for online accounts to protect your main email from data breaches
Avoid sending sensitive information through unencrypted email providers
